_comment-bump-minor-pre-major: ADR-0042: this product is pre-1.0 SemVer. release-please defaults bump-minor-pre-major to FALSE, which sends ANY breaking change (a `!` marker or BREAKING CHANGE footer) straight to 1.0.0 — and 1.0 is a PRODUCT statement (GA), not a technical one. Setting it true keeps breaking changes as MINOR bumps while under 1.0, which is what ADR-0042 already says in prose. Caught 2026-07-25: a `chore(deps)!` react-router 7->8 upgrade would otherwise have tagged v1.0.0.
